findings.quote: Filtration through celite washing with CH2Cl2
findings.message: The Filter step does not preserve the celite medium, and the CH2Cl2 Add step alone does not capture the specified washing operation. Preserve the full instruction in unmapped_actions because the permitted step fields cannot express these details.

findings.quote: Purification by chromatography on silica (0-50 % EtOAc in heptane)
findings.message: The Purify step records chromatography but omits silica and the specified 0–50% EtOAc in heptane eluent range. Preserve these source conditions in unmapped_actions.
